lines.zh: 我扛着草垛假人走过广场，没人多看一眼。
lines.en: I carry a straw dummy across the square; nobody looks twice.

lines.zh: 我踩过训练场的泥，木桩东倒西歪。
lines.en: I cross the training yard mud past leaning stakes.

lines.zh: 我绕远路走，免得被人看见我进地窖。
lines.en: I take the long way so no one sees me enter the cellar.

lines.zh: 我把银匕首藏在袖里，慢慢踱步。
lines.en: I stroll with a silver dagger hidden in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我假装赶鸡，其实在数屋顶的蝙蝠。
lines.en: I pretend to chase hens while counting roof bats.

lines.zh: 我去井边打水，顺手看了看井绳。
lines.en: I draw water and check the well rope as I go.

lines.zh: 我推着独轮车，车下压着一捆木桩。
lines.en: I push a barrow with a bundle of stakes beneath it.

lines.zh: 我沿栅栏走一圈，找松动的那块木板。
lines.en: I walk the fence line looking for the loose plank.

lines.zh: 我穿过麦田，袍子里全是草籽。
lines.en: I cut through the wheat; my coat fills with seeds.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，让影子看起来像个农夫。
lines.en: I walk slowly so my shadow looks like a farmer's.

lines.zh: 我提着大蒜串，说这是防病的偏方。
lines.en: I carry garlic strings, calling them a remedy for sickness.

lines.zh: 我踩到干草，声音轻得像猫。
lines.en: I step on straw as softly as a cat.

lines.zh: 我走进谷仓，门在身后自己合上。
lines.en: I enter the barn, and the door shuts behind me.

lines.zh: 我沿着河走，靴底沾了湿泥。
lines.en: I follow the river, wet mud clinging to my boots.

lines.zh: 我在谷仓里绑草人，绑得很紧。
lines.en: In the barn I lash a straw dummy tight.

lines.zh: 我削一根木桩，削到能一插到底。
lines.en: I whittle a stake until it will sink in one blow.

lines.zh: 我把大蒜磨成糊，涂在门闩上。
lines.en: I grind garlic into paste and smear the door bolts.

lines.zh: 我数着箭矢，短了三支。
lines.en: I count the bolts; three are missing.

lines.zh: 我磨银匕首，磨到能照见眉毛。
lines.en: I sharpen the silver dagger until it shows my brows.

lines.zh: 我在墙上划痕，记下第几个学生走了。
lines.en: I notch the wall for each student who leaves.

lines.zh: 我假装补鞋，其实在听门外的脚步。
lines.en: I pretend to mend shoes while listening for footsteps.

lines.zh: 我把训练用的小刀摆成一排，刀尖朝外。
lines.en: I line up the practice knives, points outward.

lines.zh: 我靠着草垛打盹，一只手还握着匕首。
lines.en: I doze against the straw, dagger still in hand.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂一袋银币，是学费。
lines.en: I weigh a pouch of silver, the tuition.

lines.zh: 我在教一个少年怎么握木剑。
lines.en: I teach a boy how to grip a wooden sword.

lines.zh: 我把地图摊开，圈出三处疑似巢穴。
lines.en: I spread the map and circle three suspected lairs.

lines.zh: 我擦掉靴上的泥，怕被人看出走过墓地。
lines.en: I wipe mud off my boots so no one reads the graveyard.

lines.zh: 我对着假人低声复盘，像在训话。
lines.en: I debrief the dummy in a low voice, as if lecturing.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我先看看你的手有没有茧。
lines.en: You stare at me; let me check your hands for calluses.

lines.zh: 别喊我教官，隔墙有耳。
lines.en: Do not call me instructor; walls have ears.

lines.zh: 你想学猎人？先交一块银锭。
lines.en: You want to learn hunting? Bring me a silver ingot.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着墓土，昨晚去哪了？
lines.en: Your boots carry grave dirt. Where were you last night?

lines.zh: 站直，让我看看你够不够快。
lines.en: Stand straight; let me see if you are quick.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把剑，握法全错了。
lines.en: That sword at your hip is gripped all wrong.

lines.zh: 别盯着我窗上的大蒜看，太显眼。
lines.en: Stop staring at my window garlic; it draws notice.

lines.zh: 你身上没有咬痕，说明还来得及。
lines.en: No bite marks on you, so there is still time.

lines.zh: 我这里有三根木桩，你只拿一根。
lines.en: I have three stakes; you take only one.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我的伪装哪里破了？
lines.en: What are you grinning at? Where did my disguise slip?

lines.zh: 跟着我走，别说一句话。
lines.en: Follow me and do not say a word.

lines.zh: 你若是吸血鬼派来的，现在就走。
lines.en: If the vampires sent you, leave now.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太急了，先稳住再谈。
lines.en: You breathe too fast; steady yourself first.

lines.zh: 我认得你父亲，他也学过三天。
lines.en: I knew your father; he trained for three days.

lines.zh: 你把袖子卷起来，让我看咬痕。
lines.en: Roll up your sleeve and show me the bite.

lines.zh: 别在这儿站太久，会被人记住。
lines.en: Do not linger here; people will remember you.

lines.zh: 你打中了旧伤，我半条手臂发麻。
lines.en: You hit the old wound; half my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 我吐掉嘴里的血，继续教你。
lines.en: I spit blood and keep teaching.

lines.zh: 别打头，我还要算箭数。
lines.en: Not the head; I still count my bolts.

lines.zh: 这一下比我学生打的轻多了。
lines.en: That was lighter than my students' hits.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，草人替我挡了一下。
lines.en: I fall back two steps as the dummy takes the blow.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的伪装，帽子掉了。
lines.en: You broke my disguise; my hat fell off.

lines.zh: 疼，但我不会喊出声。
lines.en: It hurts, but I will not cry out.

lines.zh: 我按住肋骨，数了三下才站稳。
lines.en: I hold my ribs and count three before standing.

lines.zh: 我的木桩掉在脚边，没扎出去。
lines.en: My stake drops at my feet, unthrown.

lines.zh: 这伤口得缝，我自己来。
lines.en: This wound needs stitching, and I will do it.

lines.zh: 那锅炖肉的味道，比箭术课香多了。
lines.en: That stew smells better than any archery lesson.

lines.zh: 有人烤面包，我的肚子先答应了。
lines.en: Someone is baking bread, and my stomach answers first.

lines.zh: 你给我一杯麦酒，我可以多教一招。
lines.en: One mug of ale and I will teach an extra move.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜的甜味让我放松了警惕。
lines.en: The smell of honey lowers my guard.

lines.zh: 那盘奶酪是谁放这的？我吃一块。
lines.en: Who left this cheese? I will take one slice.

lines.zh: 我闻到大蒜，倒不讨厌这味道。
lines.en: I smell garlic, and I do not mind it.

lines.zh: 烤肉滴油的声音，让我忘了正事。
lines.en: Meat dripping fat makes me forget my business.

lines.zh: 先吃，吃完再谈木桩的价钱。
lines.en: Let us eat first, then discuss the price of stakes.

lines.zh: 这汤太咸，但我还是喝了两碗。
lines.en: The soup is too salty, yet I drink two bowls.

lines.zh: 你把苹果放下，我数三下就没了。
lines.en: Leave the apples; I will count three and they are gone.

lines.zh: 撞我做什么？我差点掉了匕首。
lines.en: Why bump me? I nearly dropped the dagger.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，怀里的木桩滚了一地。
lines.en: I hit you and stakes roll across the ground.

lines.zh: 站稳，我扶你一把，别说是我。
lines.en: Steady; I help you up, but do not name me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的草人了，脚抬起来。
lines.en: You stepped on my dummy; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两个赶集的农夫。
lines.en: We collide like two farmers late for market.

lines.zh: 别撞门框，那后面藏着东西。
lines.en: Do not knock the door frame; something hides behind it.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你的训练就算开始。
lines.en: Bump into me, and your training has begun.

lines.zh: 你撞得我大蒜掉了两瓣。
lines.en: You knocked two garlic cloves out of my hand.

lines.zh: 小点声，撞一下不用喊。
lines.en: Quiet down; a bump needs no shouting.

lines.zh: 我肩上有旧伤，别往那边撞。
lines.en: My shoulder is old and hurt; do not bump that side.

lines.zh: 我不谈这个，训练场比婚床重要。
lines.en: Not that. The training yard matters more than a marriage bed.

lines.zh: 我发过誓，猎人不能有牵挂。
lines.en: I swore a hunter keeps no attachments.

lines.zh: 你若要成家，先想清楚夜里谁守门。
lines.en: If you marry, decide who guards the door at night.

lines.zh: 我教过一对夫妻，后来都死了。
lines.en: I trained a married pair; both died later.

lines.zh: 别把爱人带进地窖，她会被咬。
lines.en: Do not bring your love to the cellar; she will be bitten.

lines.zh: 我年轻时求过婚，被拒绝了。
lines.en: I proposed once, long ago, and was refused.

lines.zh: 婚礼我可以去，但只坐最后一排。
lines.en: I will attend a wedding, but only the last row.

lines.zh: 你把戒指藏好，别让吸血鬼闻见银。
lines.en: Hide the ring; do not let a vampire smell the silver.

lines.zh: 两个人守夜，比一个人强。
lines.en: Two on watch are better than one.

lines.zh: 我只和木桩打交道，它不会走。
lines.en: I only deal with stakes; they never leave.

lines.zh: 这支断箭我留着，还能磨成锥子。
lines.en: I keep this broken bolt; it can be ground into an awl.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉在地上的木桩，拍了拍土。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen stake and dust it off.

lines.zh: 谁丢的银币？我先收着当学费。
lines.en: Whose silver is this? I hold it as tuition.

lines.zh: 地上一瓣大蒜，我塞进口袋。
lines.en: A garlic clove on the ground goes into my pocket.

lines.zh: 我捡到一个咬痕形状的布片。
lines.en: I find a cloth scrap shaped like a bite.

lines.zh: 那是我的磨刀石，别踩。
lines.en: That is my whetstone; do not step on it.

lines.zh: 我把散落的箭矢一支支插回箭袋。
lines.en: I slot the scattered bolts back into my quiver.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指有血腥味，我不碰。
lines.en: This ring smells of blood; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我拾起一根断绳，还能当绑带。
lines.en: I pick up a snapped cord; it still binds.

lines.zh: 地上有个脚印，我照着量了量。
lines.en: There is a print on the ground; I measure it.

lines.zh: 那家伙走路不晃，不是活人。
lines.en: That one walks without swaying. Not alive.

lines.zh: 我看见它在数窗户，它今晚会来。
lines.en: I see it counting windows; it comes tonight.

lines.zh: 我摸到木桩，手就不抖了。
lines.en: I touch the stake, and my hand stops shaking.

lines.zh: 三个吸血鬼，一个在前，两个在屋顶。
lines.en: Three vampires: one ahead, two on the roof.

lines.zh: 它闻到了我身上的蒜味，退了一步。
lines.en: It smells the garlic on me and steps back.

lines.zh: 有人被拖进树林了，跟我来。
lines.en: Someone was dragged into the trees. Follow me.

lines.zh: 别出声，它正在听。
lines.en: Make no sound; it is listening.

lines.zh: 我认出这双眼睛，上周放过它一次。
lines.en: I know those eyes; I spared them last week.

lines.zh: 它披着村民的衣服，别被骗了。
lines.en: It wears villager clothes. Do not be fooled.

lines.zh: 我拉下窗帘，让它以为屋里没人。
lines.en: I draw the curtain so it thinks the house is empty.

lines.zh: 我左手木桩，右手银匕首。
lines.en: Stake in my left hand, silver dagger in my right.

lines.zh: 它绕左，我就往右压。
lines.en: It circles left, so I press right.

lines.zh: 我数它的呼吸，它本不该有。
lines.en: I count its breaths, which it should not have.

lines.zh: 再近三步，木桩就够得着。
lines.en: Three more steps and the stake will reach.

lines.zh: 我把大蒜撒在脚边，逼它踩过来。
lines.en: I scatter garlic at my feet to force it forward.

lines.zh: 它笑得像认识我，我不接话。
lines.en: It smiles as if it knows me; I say nothing.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，我只能靠耳朵。
lines.en: The lamp is out; I rely on my ears.

lines.zh: 我的靴底在响，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: My boot squeaks; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 它开始变形了，我压住心跳。
lines.en: It starts to change shape; I steady my pulse.

lines.zh: 等它扑，我不先动。
lines.en: I wait for its lunge and do not move first.

lines.zh: 木桩扎进它胸口，声音像戳湿土。
lines.en: The stake sinks into its chest like wet earth.

lines.zh: 银匕首划开它的手臂，冒白烟。
lines.en: The silver dagger opens its arm, and smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我一脚踢开它，再补一刀。
lines.en: I kick it away and follow with a second cut.

lines.zh: 它抓破我的肩膀，我照样顶上去。
lines.en: It tears my shoulder, and I still push in.

lines.zh: 我用草人挡了一下，草屑乱飞。
lines.en: I block with the dummy; straw flies everywhere.

lines.zh: 我砸它的膝盖，让它跪下来。
lines.en: I smash its knee and bring it down.

lines.zh: 匕首卡在它肋骨里，我拔了两次。
lines.en: The dagger sticks between its ribs; I pull twice.

lines.zh: 它咬我的手臂，我把蒜糊塞进去。
lines.en: It bites my arm, and I stuff garlic paste in its mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它推向阳光，它开始冒烟。
lines.en: I shove it toward sunlight, and it starts to smoke.

lines.zh: 最后一击我用的是断掉的箭。
lines.en: My last strike is with a broken bolt.

lines.zh: 我从草垛后走出来，拍了拍袖子。
lines.en: I step out from behind the straw and dust my sleeve.

lines.zh: 谷仓门开了一条缝，我先看外面。
lines.en: The barn door opens a crack; I check outside first.

lines.zh: 我背着草人，像刚从田里回来。
lines.en: I carry a dummy, like a man back from the fields.

lines.zh: 我在黎明前换了衣服，从后门出来。
lines.en: I change clothes before dawn and leave by the back door.

lines.zh: 我从地窖爬上来，手里还拿着铲子。
lines.en: I climb from the cellar still holding a shovel.

lines.zh: 集市刚开，我混进人群里。
lines.en: The market just opened; I melt into the crowd.

lines.zh: 我踩着一地碎瓦走出来，昨夜出过事。
lines.en: I walk out over broken tiles; something happened last night.

lines.zh: 我推开门，草屑从帽子上掉下来。
lines.en: I push the door open, straw falling from my hat.

lines.zh: 我在训练场中央站定，等你来。
lines.en: I take my place in the training yard and wait.

lines.zh: 钟响之前，我已经在墙外了。
lines.en: Before the bell rings, I am already beyond the wall.

lines.zh: 火星落进草人里，它烧得比我快。
lines.en: Sparks catch the dummy; it burns faster than I do.

lines.zh: 我从草垛上滑下来，摔得尾骨疼。
lines.en: I slide off the straw stack and land on my tailbone.

lines.zh: 井水灌进嘴里，我咳了半天。
lines.en: Well water fills my mouth, and I cough for a while.

lines.zh: 谷仓炸了，我被气浪掀到墙边。
lines.en: The barn blows; the blast throws me to the wall.

lines.zh: 箭射中我的腿，是我自己的货。
lines.en: A bolt hits my leg, and it is my own stock.

lines.zh: 那咒语让我手脚发沉，站不直。
lines.en: The hex weighs down my limbs; I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 两天没吃，挥刀都没力气。
lines.en: Two days without food, and my swing is weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在草人上，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning hits the dummy; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抓着草人一起掉。
lines.en: The ground vanishes; I fall gripping the dummy.
